portal_description:
GlusterFS is a key building block of Red Hat Gluster Storage. It is based on a stackable user-space design and can deliver exceptional performance for diverse workloads. GlusterFS aggregates various storage servers over network interconnections into one large, parallel network file system.

To maintain optimal stability and performance of the GlusterFS client in Red Hat Enterprise Linux, this update applies a number of bug fixes to the glusterfs packages. (BZ#1593298)

Users of glusterfs are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which fix these bugs.

abstract:
GlusterFS is a key building block of Red Hat Gluster Storage. It is based on a stackable user-space design and can deliver exceptional performance for diverse workloads. GlusterFS aggregates various storage servers over network interconnections into one large, parallel network file system.

To maintain optimal stability and performance of the GlusterFS client in Red Hat Enterprise Linux, this update applies a number of bug fixes to the glusterfs packages. (BZ#1593298)

Users of glusterfs are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which fix these bugs.
